title: Learning Performance Efficiency of College Basketball Players Using TVAE
summary: Models workload and fatigue in college basketball to flag players at risk of burnout, working from a roster too small to train on directly. TVAE generates the additional player records, so SDV's autoencoder synthesizer carries the augmentation step in a sports-science setting.
evidence: abstract: TVAE generates synthetic records to improve accuracy

title: Four-Dimensional Aircraft Trajectory Prediction with a Generative Deep Learning and Clustering Approach
summary: Predicts medium- and long-term four-dimensional aircraft trajectories for air traffic management, arguing existing methods fit the trajectory distribution poorly. C-CTGAN pairs K-medoids clustering with CTGAN's conditional generator, a named derivative that conditions on cluster membership rather than on column values alone.
evidence: abstract: proposes C-CTGAN, combining K-medoids clustering with CTGAN

title: Security-Alert Screening with Oversampling Based on Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Addresses the false alarms and missed detections that follow from skewed alert distributions in intrusion detection. CTGAN oversamples the specific alert classes that are under-observed, using its conditional sampling to target named categories rather than the minority class as a whole.
affiliations: National Institute of Information and Communications Technology

evidence: abstract: CTGAN adopted to oversample specific alert classes

summary: Analyses sugar beet productivity from field trial data, where each observation is a growing season and the record is correspondingly short. The title names Gaussian copulas and GANs as the generation methods, placing SDV's copula machinery in an agronomic setting; no abstract is indexed, so the role is read from the title alone.

title: The use of generative models to speed up the discovery of materials
summary: Argues that advanced materials gate progress across aeronautics, automotive and construction, and that candidate discovery is bounded by how few characterised compounds exist. A CTGAN is developed per material class to generate novel synthetic compounds, so SDV's conditional architecture is used to propose candidates rather than to protect data.
evidence: abstract: a CTGAN developed to generate novel synthetic compounds per material class

title: Digital Twins for Stress Management Utilizing Synthetic Data
summary: Builds health digital twins for stress management, where wearable-derived patient data is both scarce and privacy-restricted. CTGAN, TVAE and Gaussian Copula each build patient replicas, so three of SDV's synthesizers are compared inside one clinical application.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN, TVAE and Gaussian Copula used to build patient data replicas

title: Generative Adversarial Networks for Synthetic Jamming Attacks on UAVs
summary: Manufactures jamming attack data for unmanned aerial vehicles, since real attack traces are scarce and intrusion detection cannot be trained without them. CTGAN and Gaussian copulas generate those traces; the same authors' later IEEE Access paper extends this to spoofing.
evidence: abstract: CTGANs and Gaussian copulas generate synthetic jamming attacks

title: Transfer-learning-based Autotuning using Gaussian Copula
summary: Tunes high-performance computing applications empirically, where each evaluation costs a full run and the search space is large. It is described as the first generative transfer-learning autotuning approach based on the Gaussian copula: prior tuning results are modelled and sampled to propose configurations for a new problem, so SDV's copula generates search points rather than data records.
evidence: abstract: first generative transfer-learning autotuning approach based on the Gaussian copula

title: Trading Off Scalability, Privacy, and Performance in Data Synthesis
summary: Proposes two synthesis algorithms and measures them on the three-way tension between scalability, privacy and downstream model performance. SDV is one of the two systems they are measured against, alongside DataSynthesizer, so the library defines the bar the paper claims to clear.
evidence: abstract: compares the authors' two algorithms against DataSynthesizer and Synthetic Data Vault

title: A Hybrid Framework for Predicting Crash Severity in Construction Work Zones Using Knowledge Distillation and Conditional GANs
summary: Predicts crash severity in construction work zones, where fatal outcomes are rare enough that a classifier trained on the raw record learns to ignore them. CTGAN is paired with knowledge distillation to supply the missing severe-crash cases, putting SDV's conditional sampling behind a road-safety model.
venue: Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
evidence: abstract: CTGAN combined with knowledge distillation

title: Assessing the Fidelity and Utility of Water Systems Data Using Generative Adversarial Networks: A Technical Review
summary: Reviews generative approaches for water distribution system data, where operators withhold records for security and legal reasons and researchers are left without a corpus. CTGAN is among the models found effective, so the review positions SDV as a route around a data-access problem that is institutional rather than technical.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN among GAN models found effective for water distribution system data

title: DGA Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Gaussian Copula Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning
summary: Diagnoses transformer faults from dissolved gas analysis, a domain where labelled fault samples accumulate only as equipment actually fails. The title names Gaussian copula augmentation as the method feeding transfer learning; no abstract is indexed, so the role is read from the title.

title: Bridging Data Gaps: A Comparative Study of Different Imputation Methods for Numeric Datasets
summary: Benchmarks classical against modern imputation on numeric data, arguing the two families are rarely compared on equal terms. The Gaussian Copula Imputer is one of the compared methods, an unusual appearance of SDV's copula in a missing-value role rather than a generation one.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula Imputer among the imputation methods compared

title: A Comparative Analysis of Synthetic Data Generation with VAE and CTGAN Models on Financial Credit Loan Offer Data
summary: Compares generation approaches on credit loan offer data, driven by the strict privacy regulation and class balance requirements that constrain financial modelling. CTGAN is one of the two models under test, so SDV's conditional generator is measured against a plain autoencoder on regulated financial records.
evidence: title and abstract: comparative analysis of VAE and CTGAN generation

title: Enhancing Auto Insurance Fraud Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: Detects fraudulent auto insurance claims with a one-dimensional convolutional classifier, in a market where confirmed fraud is a small fraction of policies. Synthetic augmentation supplies the fraud cases the classifier would otherwise never see enough of, pairing SDV-family generation with a deep detector.

title: Exploring Synthetic Data Generation for Anomaly Detection in the 5G NWDAF Architecture
summary: Examines anomaly detection inside the 5G network data analytics function, where standalone-mode deployment is new and operational traces are not yet available at scale. CTGAN generates the NWDAF records the detector trains on, an application of SDV to a telecom control plane.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN generates synthetic 5G NWDAF records

title: C3-TGAN: Controllable Tabular Data Synthesis with Explicit Correlations and Property Constraints
summary: Argues that GAN-based tabular synthesis ignores explicit attribute correlations and property constraints, so downstream analysis of the synthetic data can reach wrong conclusions even when marginals look right. C3-TGAN adds both to the tabular GAN, a named derivative that extends the architecture rather than applying it.
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology; Peng Cheng Laboratory
Harbin Institute of Technology; Peng Cheng Laboratory
evidence: abstract: C3-TGAN adds explicit correlation and property constraints to tabular GAN synthesis

title: Innovations in early detection of chronic non-communicable diseases among adolescents through an easy-to-use AutoML paradigm
summary: Builds an interpretable AutoML pipeline for early detection of hypertension and hyperinsulinemia in adolescents, from a national screening cohort collected over four years. TVAE augments the data points fed to three AutoML frameworks, so SDV sits upstream of the modelling rather than being evaluated by it.
evidence: abstract: TVAE used with three AutoML frameworks to augment data points

title: An Open-Access Dataset of Hospitalized Cardiac-Arrest Patients
summary: Publishes an open-access dataset of hospitalized cardiac arrest patients so that prediction research can proceed in settings where clinical documentation is the only available record. The release is synthetic and generated with SDV, which makes the library the reason a dataset of this kind could be published at all.
evidence: abstract: work revolved around generating and utilizing synthetic data via synthetic data vaults

title: Row Conditional-TGAN for Generating Synthetic Relational Databases
summary: Observes that synthesizing a relational database means reproducing the relationships between tables, not only each table's own distribution. RC-TGAN extends the tabular GAN with row-level conditioning on parent rows, making it a direct competitor to HMA built on the first-party generator.
evidence: abstract: RC-TGAN extends the tabular GAN to relational databases

title: Performance Enhancement of Malware Classifiers Using Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Reports competition results for improving a malware classifier by generating additional malign samples. CTGAN is used alongside CTAB-GAN, so SDV's synthesizer is one of two conditional tabular generators applied to the same imbalance under contest conditions.

evidence: abstract: CTGAN employed alongside CTAB-GAN for imbalance

title: A comparison study on creating simulated patient data for individuals suffering from chronic coronary disorders
summary: Compares five techniques for building virtual patient populations to augment clinical research databases that are short of subjects. Four of the five are SDV's, Tabular Preset, Gaussian Copula, CTGAN and a CTGAN variant, so the comparison is largely internal to the library.

title: Tabular Generative Adversarial Networks for Flood Forecasting from Meteorological data
summary: Forecasts floods from meteorological records, motivated by how poorly mitigation has kept pace with the damage. CTGAN is applied to numerical augmentation of the existing record rather than to free generation, a distinction the paper draws explicitly.
evidence: abstract: applies CTGAN to numerical data augmentation rather than random generation

title: Synthetic Flight Data Generation Using Generative Models
summary: Tests whether generative models can produce realistic flight data, since aviation research is limited by both scarcity and commercial confidentiality, and assesses quality through a four-stage framework. TVAE and Gaussian Copula are the two models adapted, so SDV supplies both arms of the study.
evidence: abstract: TVAE and Gaussian Copula adapted to generate flight information

title: Challenges and Limitations of TVAE Tabular Synthetic Data Generator
summary: Identifies TVAE as part of the Synthetic Data Vault and then modifies its generation algorithm, adding a second encoder-decoder pair to oversample under-represented categorical subclasses.
